text: DSH 对话大纲（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 DSH Web 的 better-sidebar 中提供按轮次组织的当前会话大纲。它从会话事件构建用户、助手和工具活动条目，并提供点击跳转到对应消息的面板；宿主端还可为每轮生成并缓存一句话标题。适合需要快速浏览长会话并定位消息的 DSH Web 用户。使用时需要 DSH Web、dsh-better-sidebar v0.12.0+，标题由已配置的模型服务生成。

DSH Conversation Outline adds a turn based outline to the DSH Web sidebar. It groups session activity and lets users jump to messages. The host can generate and cache short titles for each turn using the configured model. Requires DSH Web and dsh-better-sidebar v0.12.0+.
想在 DSH Web 侧栏里快速看清长对话的轮次结构
能不能点大纲里的条目直接跳到那条消息？
我想给每轮对话生成一句话标题，方便查找
DSH Web 有没有按轮次整理当前会话的侧栏？
我希望快速找到旧对话中的某个助手回复
会话里的工具调用和回答太多，想按轮次整理浏览
工具调用和助手回复混在一起时，我想按轮次分组查看会话
有没有办法给旧会话各轮自动起简短标题并复用标题？
I want to scan a long DSH conversation by turn and jump to a message.
Can DSH create short titles for each conversation turn?
DSH 对话大纲的功能「按轮次浏览」：把当前会话事件组织成大纲条目，展示用户、助手和工具活动。打开侧栏标签即可浏览。
DSH 对话大纲的功能「跳转到消息」：点击大纲条目后定位到相应会话消息，便于在长对话中快速查看上下文。
DSH 对话大纲的功能「轮次标题」：宿主使用当前配置的模型服务为轮次文本生成简短标题，并缓存结果供大纲显示。
DSH 对话大纲生成轮次标题时，会把构造出的当前轮可见文本交给已配置的模型服务；标题结果在浏览器本地缓存。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 概览：**适合谁**：使用 DeepSeek Harness Web（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）、希望快速
浏览当前会话结构、不用来回滚动长对话的用户。

**解决什么问题**：

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 概览：- **按轮次结构化大纲** —— 用户消息、助手回复、工具调用（连续调用自动合并为可折叠分组）、
  压缩检查点、错误行，全部按轮次分组展示。
- **一键跳转** —— 点击任意条目，自动加载历史并滚动到聊天视图 / 轨迹视图的对应行。
- **每轮一句话标题** —— Host 直接调用 `llm.stream` 生成（不创建 subagent），
  按内容指纹缓存；分支会话前缀相同即可复用标题。
- **标题生成完全并行** —— 已结束轮次即时生成，即使 agent 仍在处理后续轮次；
  只有当前进行中的轮次等待本轮结束。
- **可配置** —— 标题模型、推理等级、并发数、单次超时、失败重试、禁用开关，
  全部在齿轮设置中持久化。
- **窄面板自动收缩** —— 面板变窄（≤360px）时，行内类型标签（用户/助手/工具等）
  自动从文字收缩为图标（悬停显示文字），与轨迹视图行为一致。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 效果图：

> 右侧边栏中的「对话大纲」面板：按轮次折叠展示，每轮带 LLM 标题，点击任意条目可跳转到对应消息。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 重启与启用：重启 DSH：

```powershell
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

打开 better-sidebar 的 **+ 菜单**，选择「对话大纲」。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 卸载：```powershell
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline
```

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 快速开始：1. 安装插件后启动 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`。
2. 打开任意会话，在侧边栏 + 菜单添加「对话大纲」tab。
3. 大纲展示每轮及其 LLM 标题；点击条目即可跳转。
4. 可选：齿轮设置里选择标题模型 / 推理等级，或调整超时与重试。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 配置：持久化到 better-sidebar `pluginSettings['conversation-outline']`
（`localStorage` 键 `dsh-conversation-outline-settings:v1` 作为旧版回退）。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 配置：| 键 | 默认 | 范围 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `''` | — | 标题模型；空 = 跟随主会话模型 |
| `reasoningEffort` | `''` | off / low / medium / high / max | 推理等级；空 = 跟随会话 |
| `maxConcurrency` | `3` | 1–8 | 客户端并发生成标题的 worker 数 |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `60` | 5–300 | 单次尝试超时；对**整个尝试**生效（`Promise.race` 强制） |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | 0–5 | 失败重试次数（退避 0.8s 起，封顶 5s） |
| `disabled` | `false` | — | 完全禁用标题生成 |

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 权限与数据：- **会话日志**：Host 通过 `ctx.sessionQuery`（`readSession` / `listEvents`）只读当前会话日志构建大纲，不回写。
- **LLM 调用**：标题生成只把当前轮可见文本（用户 + 助手块，去掉工具调用，截断）发送到配置的模型路由，提示词为固定短摘要指令。
- **浏览器存储**：标题缓存于 `localStorage`（`dsh-conversation-outline-titles:v1`）；设置在 `pluginSettings` + `localStorage`。
- **不读取任何凭据**；除配置的模型 provider 外无其他网络访问。

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 含义 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 标题一直「等待本轮结束...」 | 该轮尚无 `turn/end` 事件，是当前运行中的轮次；本轮结束后自动生成。 |
| 「未生成 · title timeout after ...」 | 单次尝试超过 `timeoutSeconds`（网络/模型卡顿）。调大超时或检查模型路由。 |
| 「未生成 · signals[0] is not of type AbortSignal」 | 静态 Host（Node）有真实 `AbortController`，正常不应出现；如出现请附日志反馈。 |
| 更新后标题不生效 | 静态包与 Host 半需要**完整重启** `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`，再刷新浏览器。 |
| 没有「对话大纲」tab | 确认 better-sidebar v0.12.0+ 且插件已安装（`dsh --profile web --dump-config`）。 |
| 失败标题缓存 60 秒 | 瞬时错误缓存 60s 后自动重试；确定性错误（无文本 / 无 Agent / 无模型参数）永久返回。 |

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Overview：For whom: users of **DeepSeek Harness Web** (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`) who want a
quick navigable map of the ongoing conversation instead of scrolling a long chat
history.

What it solves:

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Overview：- **Structured per-turn outline** — user messages, assistant replies, tool calls
  (consecutive ones auto-merge into collapsible groups), compaction checkpoints
  and error rows are grouped by turn.
- **One-click jump** — click any entry; the plugin loads older history as needed
  and scrolls to the exact row in both the chat view and the trajectory view.
- **One-line LLM title per turn** — the Host calls `llm.stream` directly (no
  subagent), caches by content fingerprint, and reuses titles across forked
  sessions with the same prefix.
- **Fully parallel title generation** — ended turns generate immediately, even
  while the agent is still working on a later turn; only the still-open current
  turn waits for its own turn to finish.
- **Configurable** — title model, reasoning effort, concurrency, per-attempt
  timeout, retry count and a master disable switch, persisted via the gear
  settings panel.
- **Auto-collapse on narrow panels** — when the panel gets narrow (≤360px), the
  per-row kind tags (user / assistant / tool, etc.) collapse from text into
  icons (hover shows the full label), matching the trajectory view's behavior

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Screenshot：

> The **对话大纲** panel in the right sidebar: per-turn collapsible outline with > LLM titles; click any entry to jump to the matching message.

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Quick start：1. Start `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` with the plugin installed.
2. Open any conversation; open the sidebar and add the **对话大纲** tab.
3. The outline shows every turn with its LLM title; click a row to jump.
4. Optional: open the gear settings to pick a title model / reasoning effort, or
   tune timeout and retries.

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Configuration：Stored in better-sidebar `pluginSettings['conversation-outline']`
(`localStorage` `dsh-conversation-outline-settings:v1` is the legacy fallback).

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Range | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `''` | — | Title model; empty = follow the main session model |
| `reasoningEffort` | `''` | off / low / medium / high / max | Reasoning effort; empty = follow the session |
| `maxConcurrency` | `3` | 1–8 | Client-side parallel title workers |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `60` | 5–300 | Per-attempt timeout; enforced over the WHOLE attempt via `Promise.race` |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | 0–5 | Retry count on failure (backoff 0.8s → capped 5s) |
| `disabled` | `false` | — | Disable title generation entirely |

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Permissions & data：- **Session logs**: Host reads the live session log via `ctx.sessionQuery`
  (`readSession` / `listEvents`) to build the outline; nothing is written back
  to the session.
- **LLM call**: title generation sends only the current turn's visible text
  (user + assistant blocks, tools removed, truncated) to the configured model
  route; the prompt is a fixed short summarization instruction.
- **Browser storage**: generated titles are cached in `localStorage`
  (`dsh-conversation-outline-titles:v1`); settings in
  `pluginSettings` + `localStorage`.
- **No credentials / no network beyond the configured model provider.** The
  plugin never reads API keys or other secrets.

dsh-client-ui-conversation-outline README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Meaning / fix |
| --- | --- |
| Title stays "等待本轮结束..." | The turn has no `turn/end` event yet; it is the currently-running turn. It generates automatically when the turn ends. |
| "未生成 · title timeout after ..." | An attempt exceeded `timeoutSeconds` (network/model stall). Raise the timeout or check the model route. |
| "未生成 · signals[0] is not of type AbortSignal" | Should not happen on the static host (Node provides a real `AbortController`); report it with logs. |
| Titles never appear after update | Static packages + Host half need a FULL restart of `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, then refresh the browser. |
| No "对话大纲" tab | Confirm better-sidebar v0.12.0+ and that the plugin is installed (`dsh --profile web --dump-config`). |
| Failed title stays cached 60s | Transient errors cache 60s then auto-retry; deterministic errors (no text, no agent, no model) return permanently. |
